dialog.title: Request more AI capacity
dialog.subtitle: University AI energy is distributed by a platform administrator — describe what you need and they will review it.
dialog.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Reviewing a large cohort of CVs before the career fair
dialog.reasonHelp: Explain briefly why your current weekly AI energy is not enough.
dialog.unitsHelp: An estimate of the extra weekly energy you need. The admin may grant a different amount.
dialog.reasonRequired: Please describe why you need more AI energy.
dialog.unitsInvalid: Enter a positive number of energy credits.
dialog.alreadyPending: You already have a capacity request awaiting a decision.
dialog.error: Could not send your request. Please try again.

staff.title: My AI capacity
staff.subtitle: Your weekly AI energy is distributed by a platform administrator. When it runs low, request more here.
staff.emptyBody: You have not asked for extra AI energy. If you run out during the week, send a request and an admin will review it.
staff.errorBody: Something went wrong loading your capacity requests.
staff.unlimitedBody: Your account is exempt from AI energy limits, so there is nothing to request.
staff.pendingBanner: You have a capacity request awaiting a decision.
